josaa-csab.IIT: Admission to this IIT is through JoSAA counselling, based on your JEE Advanced rank.
josaa-csab.NIT: Admission is through JoSAA counselling based on your JEE Main rank. CSAB special rounds follow JoSAA for seats that remain vacant.
josaa-csab.IIIT: Admission is through JoSAA counselling based on your JEE Main rank. CSAB special rounds follow JoSAA for seats that remain vacant.
josaa-csab.GFTI: Admission is through JoSAA counselling based on your JEE Main rank. CSAB special rounds follow JoSAA for seats that remain vacant.

mhtcet: Admission is through the Maharashtra CAP counselling run by the State CET Cell, based on MHT-CET merit.
